premises: Local chemical order (LCO) can be enhanced by low-temperature annealing in single-phase equiatomic alloys like CrCoNi or NiCoCr.
Enhanced LCO creates spatial fluctuations in local shear or stacking-fault energies.
These fault-energy fluctuations create additional dislocation pinning sites.
Dislocation pinning at these sites increases the activation barrier for glide, raising yield strength and strain hardening.
This mechanism delays strain localization and failure during room-temperature tensile deformation.
